provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: quite the opposite; on the contrary
patterns.usage_note: Denies what was expected of the first item and states the contrary instead: 効くどころか熱が上がった, 反省どころか文句を言う. The sibling lane is the scale contrast, where the second item pushes the same point further, marked with まで or, under a negative, も (スマホどころかタブレットまで, 旅行どころか外食もできない). かえって often marks the reversal, and it attaches to a bare noun with no particle and to the plain form of verbs and い-adjectives.

examples.ruby: あいつは反省[はんせい]どころか、こっちに文句[もんく]を言[い]ってきた。
examples.english: Sorry? Far from it, he turned around and complained at me.

examples.ruby: この薬[くすり]は効[き]くどころか、かえって熱[ねつ]が上[あ]がった。
examples.english: Far from helping, this medicine actually pushed my fever higher.

examples.ruby: 今年[ことし]の夏[なつ]は涼[すず]しいどころか、去年[きょねん]より暑[あつ]い日[ひ]が続[つづ]いている。
examples.english: This summer is anything but cool, we're getting even hotter days than last year.
